note: All-ages RV resort on US-19 in Clearwater (RHP); heated pool. Mix of transient and long-term, tight sites. --Claude
summary: Operator's page and Aug 2026-Jul 2027 rate sheet: confirmed $70-80 daily (taxes and utilities included), water/sewer, year-round, phone booking with a $100 deposit. Added laundry, Wi-Fi. No per-person resort fee (the Avalon AWH skipped was a different park, Paw Paw WV, with a $50/couple day fee). Not stated: amps, site count/lengths. Note cleaned of field facts.
flags: Price gate: base $70/night out of season, $80 in season (operator's 2026-27 rate sheet; Good Sam 10% would still be $63-72), over US$50. Nearest gateway St. Petersburg metro, 20 km (Tampa 27 km), so the gateway exception applies. The family has not stayed here (no trip references).

Long-stay check: the rate sheet sells daily, weekly, monthly, seasonal and annual stays (annual $650/month with application and one-month deposit), and the page lists mailboxes, trash collection 'Included in Rent' and links Bayshore Home Sales. Nights are for sale by phone with a deposit (no application for daily), so it seems to pass test 2; whether it is mostly seasonal/annual cannot be told from the pages.
